flows.label: $50B equity investment paid
flows.newsBrief: All installments completed by the Q2 filing; final payment day is unspecified.

flows.label: $18B cumulative investment paid
flows.newsBrief: $18B paid cumulatively; remaining $15B is conditional and is excluded from the paid-only model.

flows.label: Up to $15B remaining Amazon facility
flows.newsBrief: After Amazon funded $5B in Series H, up to $15B remained under its 2026 note purchase agreement. Availability is conditional and ends 30 months after the IPO or earlier upon termination of certain commercial agreements.

flows.label: $2B equity investment closed
flows.newsBrief: Cash investment in CoreWeave Class A shares.

flows.label: $6.3B initial capacity backstop
flows.newsBrief: NVIDIA may purchase residual unsold compute; availability, delivery and termination conditions apply. This is cloud service demand, not a second GPU order.

flows.label: $30B round participation
flows.newsBrief: OpenAI closed a round of committed capital; NVIDIA-specific cash payment timing is unverified. The older September 2025 $100B letter of intent is not added.

flows.label: Up to $10B NVIDIA investment
flows.newsBrief: Historical announced ceiling. The IPO close confirms a $10B NVIDIA purchase. The final prospectus does not reconcile the two, so the chart counts only the completed amount.

reconciliation.notes: Historical announced ceiling. The IPO close confirms a $10B NVIDIA purchase. The final prospectus does not reconcile the two, so the chart counts only the completed amount.

flows.label: $11.9B cumulative funding paid
flows.newsBrief: Funded portion of a cumulative $13B commitment; this is not a new annual investment.

flows.label: $1.1B remaining funding commitment
flows.newsBrief: $13B total less $11.9B funded. Azure contract duration is undisclosed, so no annual funding-to-purchases schedule is inferred.

flows.label: $36B residual-capacity obligations
flows.newsBrief: Conditional compute purchases. Scheduled $6B FY2028, $8B FY2029, $7B FY2030, $6B FY2031, $9B thereafter; use by others or NVIDIA can reduce residual amounts.

reconciliation.notes: Do not add this aggregate to CoreWeave capacity support without reconciling overlap.

flows.label: Up to $105B contingent tenant guarantee
flows.newsBrief: Initial 4.25GW project; up to 20-year term, conditional readiness and tenant defaults, with OpenAI indemnity. Maximum notional is not expected loss. Separate planned $1.5B equity is not treated as paid.

flows.label: Up to 160M warrant shares · $0.01 exercise
flows.newsBrief: Equity incentive contingent on purchases and share-price milestones; not cash financing. Exercise price is not fair value.

flows.label: Up to 160M warrant shares · $0.01 exercise
flows.newsBrief: Equity incentive contingent on purchases and share-price milestones; not cash financing. Exercise price is not fair value.

flows.label: $100B incremental AWS contract · 8 years
flows.newsBrief: Additional to an earlier $38B contract. Spending schedule and financing attribution are undisclosed.

flows.label: >$100B incremental AWS contract · 10 years
flows.newsBrief: Existing commitments are excluded from this incremental amount.

reconciliation.notes: Historical announcement. Current chart uses the latest terms in anth-amazon-purchase-2026-prospectus.

flows.label: $250B incremental Azure contract
flows.newsBrief: April 2026 amendment permits other clouds. OpenAI-to-Microsoft revenue share continues through 2030 with an undisclosed cap.

flows.label: $30B Azure compute commitment
flows.newsBrief: Plus infrastructure of up to 1GW; do not treat 1GW as an additional cash amount.

reconciliation.notes: Historical announcement. Current chart uses the latest terms in anth-ms-purchase-2026-prospectus.

flows.label: NVIDIA hardware purchases · $ undisclosed
flows.newsBrief: The portion purchased with this equity cannot be traced from public disclosures.

flows.label: Up to $5B Microsoft investment
flows.newsBrief: Historical announced ceiling. The IPO close confirms a $1B Microsoft purchase. No separate payable balance under the old announcement is quantified in the final prospectus.

reconciliation.notes: Historical announced ceiling. The IPO close confirms a $1B Microsoft purchase. No separate payable balance under the old announcement is quantified in the final prospectus.

flows.label: At least $110B AWS compute
flows.newsBrief: Take-or-pay with a true-up subject to adjustments and exceptions. The prospectus gives the minimum for the April 2026 agreement. The prior more-than-$100B announcement is retained in history.

flows.label: $47.2B–$49.2B · Azure compute
flows.newsBrief: Minimum of $47.2B and maximum of $49.2B after amendments through November 2026. Spend is due regardless of usage, with uncured breach and certain undelivered-tranche exceptions.

flows.label: At least $121.3B Google Cloud hosting
flows.newsBrief: Minimum spending regardless of use, with true-up subject to certain exceptions. The separately estimated $125B–$150B of additional TPU capacity has no fixed dollar commitment and may be hosted by Google or sourced through third parties.

flows.label: $161.2B TPU equipment leases
flows.newsBrief: Approximate life-of-lease rent excluding interest. Broadcom originated the leases and assigned some to financing entities. Payments usually begin when equipment is ready.

flows.label: Up to $120.5B SpaceXAI GPU compute
flows.newsBrief: After lock-in periods ending in January or March 2027, either party can cancel the respective arrangements on 90 days’ notice.

flows.label: Up to $44.6B Nscale GPU services
flows.newsBrief: Fees accrue as capacity is accepted. The terms include qualifying financing efforts and limited cancellation rights.

flows.label: $41.3B Lambda GPU services
flows.newsBrief: Approximately $34.9B relates to an agreement either party may terminate because Lambda missed a facility-lease milestone. Neither had given notice at the prospectus date.

flows.label: AMD Helios procurement · price unfixed
flows.newsBrief: Anthropic expects spending above $20B if it procures the entire initial tranche. Pricing, financing and other deployment conditions apply. The agreement has no fixed dollar value and capacity can be arranged through approved third parties.

flows.label: Up to $10B remaining Google facility
flows.newsBrief: The IPO placement used $10B of the $20B capacity available before closing. A separate $10B Series H investment had already reduced the original $30B facility.

flows.label: Up to $42B Broadcom rent financing
flows.newsBrief: Restricted to specified rent obligations under the 2026 equipment lease. Broadcom may assign the agreement to a financing partner. No notes were issued under this facility as of September 30.

flows.label: Up to $2.5B AMD equity remaining
flows.newsBrief: The original up-to-$5B purchase-linked commitment was reduced by AMD’s $2.5B private placement purchase. Remaining funding depends on delivery and acceptance milestones.

flows.label: $10B Google Series H investment
flows.newsBrief: Separate from Google’s $10B purchase at the November 20 close. Both draw on the original $30B Google agreement.

flows.label: $10B Google private placement
flows.newsBrief: The $10B closed purchase draws on its existing note purchase agreement, leaving up to $10B available.

flows.label: $10B NVIDIA private placement
flows.newsBrief: The $10B closed purchase is the NVIDIA amount counted in sensitivity calculations. The older announced ceiling is excluded from the funding total because overlap is unresolved.

flows.label: $2.5B AMD private placement
flows.newsBrief: The $2.5B closed purchase reduces its original up-to-$5B milestone-linked equity commitment.

flows.label: $1B Broadcom private placement
flows.newsBrief: Completed equity purchase. The conditional $42B rent-financing facility is a separate instrument.

flows.label: $1B Micron private placement
flows.newsBrief: Completed Class N equity purchase at the $83 IPO price.

flows.label: $1B Microsoft private placement
flows.newsBrief: Completed Class N equity purchase. The older up-to-$5B announcement is retained for historical reference and omitted from current funding totals.

flows.label: $0.5B TSMC private placement
flows.newsBrief: Completed Class N equity purchase at the $83 IPO price.

sources.title: Closing of IPO and concurrent private placement
